column1: # U9: the vault browser. Format: see the header of ~/.config/hub/hub.

column9: One list of every Bitwarden item (login, card, identity, note, SSH key) over rbw. Tab / Shift+Tab cycle the folders and the Trash; the preview masks every secret and shows the live TOTP code, custom fields and attachments. y copies the password, u the user, o the TOTP code, f any field, t types user+Tab+password, e edits the item as JSON, n creates one, d moves it to the trash, r restores it, h history, F attachments, S Send, w generator, s sync, L lock. Trash, attachments, edit and new use the bw CLI (master password once per login); everything else rbw. `vault-browse --here` runs it in a terminal.
